# Celoris
Celoris Designs LLP is India's all-in-one AI creative studio, certified academy, and remote job center for students, creators, and freelancers since 2019. Start free (₹0 forever tier; Pro plans from ₹499/mo) with no credit card required.

Updated: 2026-11-25

## Core Features & Proof Pages
- [Pricing & Plans](https://celorisdesigns.com/pricing) - Transparent ₹0 free tier and Pro studio/academy plans.
- [Verified Reviews](https://celorisdesigns.com/reviews) - Real student, creator, and client reviews across India.
- [About Celoris](https://celorisdesigns.com/about) - Registered Indian LLP (Est. May 23, 2019), team, and mission.
- [Contact Us](https://celorisdesigns.com/contact) - Direct support and partnership inquiries.
- [Free Online Video Editor](https://celorisdesigns.com/video-studio) - High-performance 4K timeline browser video editor.
- [Prompt Box](https://celorisdesigns.com/prompt-box) - Tested Seedance AI video & commercial prompts with 1-click copy.
- [PhotoLite Image Studio](https://celorisdesigns.com/photolite) - Photoshop-style browser photo & PSD editor.
- [Certified Job Center](https://celorisdesigns.com/job-center) - 10-minute certification exams unlocking direct remote freelance & agency roles.
- [Teach & Earn Platform](https://celorisdesigns.com/teach) - Host live classes and monetize your teaching expertise.
- [PolyVault 3D](https://celorisdesigns.com/polyvault) - Marketplace for buying, selling, and generating 3D assets.
- [Live Classrooms](https://celorisdesigns.com/classrooms) - Interactive trainer-led classrooms and whiteboard rooms.

## Featured Syllabi

### AI & Developer Courses
- [Vibe Coding Mastery](https://celorisdesigns.com/courses/vibe-coding-mastery) - App building where AI does the heavy lifting.
- [Mastering Multimodal AI](https://celorisdesigns.com/courses/mastering-multimodal-ai) - Build with Vision, Voice, and Multi-modal APIs.
- [Accelerating Science with GenAI](https://celorisdesigns.com/courses/accelerating-science-generative-ai-for-research-innovation) - Generative AI for academic and industrial research.
- [Agentic AI Systems Design](https://celorisdesigns.com/courses/agentic-ai-systems-design-build-deploy) - Build and scale production-ready AI agent frameworks.
- [LangChain in Action](https://celorisdesigns.com/courses/langchain-in-action-real-workflows) - Orchestrate real-world LLM flows and agents.

- [The Short-Form Video Masterclass — YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels](https://celorisdesigns.com/learn/course/master-youtube-shorts-instagram-reels) - Live 10-hour online masterclass for Indian creators.
